profile.scope: Instrumented single-thread Python execution, not judge runtime. Self excludes traced child calls; inclusive includes them. Nested blocks and recursive inclusive times overlap; do not add rows. Loop hits count header visits, including the final condition check. Wall includes waiting and throttling; CPU excludes sleep. Unvisited blocks have zero hits. Guest observations are not authenticated.
